name: Sunkenland
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The flooded-world survival game of diving, building and raids. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated, with a starter world.

config.startup: {"done": "Server Start Complete, Ready for Clients to Join"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Sunkenland. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2667530) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously (the Windows version, run under Wine).
# Worlds are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2667530}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server runs a world made in the game, found by its GUID. With the
# starter world's GUID and no world by it yet, the starter world is copied in.
worlds="/mnt/server/.wine/drive_c/users/container/AppData/LocalLow/Vector3 Studio/Sunkenland/Worlds"
guid="${WORLD_GUID:-11223344-5566-7788-99aa-bbccddeeff00}"
mkdir -p "$worlds"
if compgen -G "$worlds/*~$guid" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Found the world with GUID $guid."
elif [ "$guid" = 11223344-5566-7788-99aa-bbccddeeff00 ]; then
    echo "Downloading the starter world"
    work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work/World~$guid"
    trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
    while read -r sum file; do
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -o "$work/World~$guid/$file" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/eb82d02cc5146b2c4b7746844fea0a4ace691200/sunkenland/world_files/Worlds/World~11223344-5566-7788-99aa-bbccddeeff00/$file" ||
            fail "The starter world can't be downloaded right now. Reinstall to try again."
        echo "$sum  $work/World~$guid/$file" | sha256sum -c --quiet - || fail "The starter world download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    done <<'EOF'
e389395bcc388fcfd6d440b97b791385e09f6d6fc283f6693eebd9e6a3e0ff6f StartGameConfig.json
0cdd81bf35b57d06f7e4d3c8042e788e6c463ad01487cce5c118ddd2dfb0bd5b WorldSetting.json
efd592cc2a818541aa665af78b4c287a679e6a1ce9d4e9655f47b2abef43a746 world.json
EOF
    : > "$work/World~$guid/AdminSteamIDs.txt"
    : > "$work/World~$guid/BanSteamIDs.txt"
    mv "$work/World~$guid" "$worlds/"
else
    echo "There's no world with GUID $guid yet. Upload one made in the game to Worlds (its folder ends in ~$guid) before starting."
fi
echo "Installed Sunkenland build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: World GUID
variables.description: The GUID of the world to run, the part after ~ in its folder name; the default is the starter world.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with (up to 8 characters), or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once, from 3 to 15.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: The region the server is listed in: asia, cn (mainland China), jp, eu, sa, kr, us (east) or usw (west).

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
